requirements.requirement: The system must render an overall score header when a valid explainability payload with a score field is present.
The system must display the overall score as a normalized value (e.g., 0–100 or equivalent format defined in schema) consistent with the schema from EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must render a list of measure rows when the payload contains a non-empty measures array.
The system must display each measure row with its name, score, and contribution value if present in the payload.
The system must render contribution visualization (e.g., bar or percentage) for each measure when contribution data is available.
The system must ensure contribution visualizations are proportionally scaled relative to other measures in the same payload.
The system must integrate explainability rendering within the existing MessageBubble structured rendering pipeline without breaking markdown rendering.
The system must render explainability content only when the payload matches the schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must maintain consistent visual hierarchy: score header above measure rows and measure rows above contribution visualizations.
The system must support rendering of explainability content within a single chat message without requiring page navigation.
The system must gracefully omit contribution visualization for a measure if its contribution value is missing or null while still rendering the measure row.
The system must render a fallback text indicator (e.g., 'No measures available') when the measures array is empty.
The system must not throw runtime errors when the explainability payload is malformed and must instead skip rendering the explainability block.
The system must ensure that rendering logic executes deterministically for identical payload inputs (no randomness in visual output).
The system must support rendering multiple explainability blocks within a single conversation thread without UI collision or overwrite.
